item.title: Tensorboard
item.description:
TensorBoard: Visualization Toolkit for ML

When to Use This Skill

Use TensorBoard when you need to:

  • Visualize training metrics like loss and accuracy over time
  • Debug models with histograms and distributions
  • Compare experiments across multiple runs
  • Visualize model graphs and architecture
  • Project embeddings to lower dimensions (t-SNE, PCA)
  • Track hyperparameter experiments
  • Profile performance and identify bottlenecks
  • Visualize images and text during training

Users: 20M+ downloads/year | GitHub Stars: 27k+ | License: Apache 2.0

item.title: ML Model Debugger
item.description:
Overview

ML Model Debugger is a debugging tool designed specifically for machine learning engineers, helping you quickly locate and resolve various issues during model training and inference.

Core Features

  • Training Diagnostics: Automatically detect gradient vanishing/explosion, overfitting, and other issues
  • Performance Analysis: Identify model inference performance bottlenecks
  • Data Validation: Check data quality and distribution
  • Visualization: Provide rich visualization tools
  • Framework Support: Support mainstream frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX

Use Cases

  • Model training not converging
  • Inference speed too slow
  • Abnormal model performance
  • Data preprocessing issues

Advanced Features

Automatic Fix Suggestions

Generate fix code suggestions based on detected issues.

item.title: ML Model Debugger
item.description:
为什么选择这个 Skill？

训练机器学习模型时，每个人都会遇到这些噩梦：

  • 训练不收敛：loss 上下波动或停滞不前，不知从何下手
  • 神秘的 NaN：训练到一半 loss 突然变成 NaN，几小时心血白费
  • 过拟合黑洞：训练集 99% 准确率，测试集却只有 60%
  • 性能陷阱：模型能跑，但推理慢到无法生产部署

这个技能就像给你配了一个 24/7 在线的 ML 专家，瞬间定位问题根因并给出可执行的修复方案。

核心功能

🔍 训练诊断（Training Diagnostics）

自动检测并诊断常见训练问题：

梯度异常检测

  • 梯度消失（Vanishing Gradients）：识别哪些层的梯度接近 0
  • 梯度爆炸（Exploding Gradients）：捕获异常大的梯度值
  • 死神经元（Dead Neurons）：找出永远不激活的神经元

过拟合/欠拟合分析

  • 自动计算 Train/Val 差距
  • 评估模型容量是否匹配数据规模
  • 建议正则化策略（Dropout、Weight Decay、Data Augmentation）

学习率问题

  • 检测学习率是否过大/过小
  • 建议最优学习率范围
  • 分析 warmup 和 decay 策略

⚡ 性能分析（Performance Profiling）

精确定位推理瓶颈：

逐层耗时分析

│ Layer │ Time │ Percent │ GPU Mem │
├────────────────────┼──────────┼─────────┼──────────┤

│ MultiHeadAttention │ 450ms │ 75% │ 2.1GB │
│ FeedForward │ 80ms │ 13% │ 800MB │
│ LayerNorm │ 5ms │ 1% │ 50MB │
│ Others │ 53ms │ 9% │ 200MB │
└────────────────────┴──────────┴─────────┴──────────┘
